name: Qoupay Ultimate Runtime
author: bagasalvi99@gmail.com
description: Qoupay Indonesia multi-runtime shell with GitHub auto-update. Includes Node.js, Bun, Python, FFmpeg, Go, Redis, MariaDB client, PM2, PNPM, Speedtest CLI, Nodemon, Chromium, yt-dlp, Playwright and Cloudflare Tunnel.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "==========================================="
echo "        QOUPAY ULTIMATE INSTALLER"
echo "==========================================="

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    curl \
    jq \
    file \
    unzip \
    ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server || true
git config --global --add safe.directory /home/container || true

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" = "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" = "1" ]; then
    echo "User upload mode enabled. Skip Git clone."
    exit 0
fi

if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
    echo "GIT_ADDRESS kosong. Skip Git clone."
    exit 0
fi

GIT_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
case "${GIT_URL}" in
    *.git) ;;
    *) GIT_URL="${GIT_URL}.git" ;;
esac

if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    REPO_PATH="$(echo "${GIT_URL}" | sed -E 's#^https?://##')"
    GIT_URL="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${REPO_PATH}"
fi

BRANCH_NAME="${BRANCH:-main}"
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0

echo "Repository : ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
echo "Branch     : ${BRANCH_NAME}"

if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo ".git ditemukan. Sinkronisasi repository..."
    if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        git remote set-url origin "${GIT_URL}"
    else
        git remote add origin "${GIT_URL}"
    fi

    git fetch --force --prune origin "${BRANCH_NAME}"
    git checkout -B "${BRANCH_NAME}" "origin/${BRANCH_NAME}" --force || true
    git reset --hard "origin/${BRANCH_NAME}"
else
    if [ "$(find /mnt/server -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 | head -n 1)" ]; then
        echo "/mnt/server tidak kosong dan .git tidak ada."
        echo "Membersihkan folder sebelum clone..."
        find /mnt/server -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} +
    fi

    git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH_NAME}" "${GIT_URL}" .
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo "Installing Node.js dependencies..."
    npm install --omit=dev
fi

echo "==========================================="
echo "        INSTALL COMPLETE"
echo "==========================================="
